decision: Only portable behavior is reimplemented; host values and private adapters are excluded.
Only cross-platform user-facing behavior is reimplemented; machine policy is excluded.
Profiles are rebuilt from public capability composition rather than copied.
Credentials, secret paths, and secret-provider wiring never enter the public tree.
Private agent estates and service topology are not publishable modules.
Private source metadata is inventory evidence only and is not redistributed.
Host composition, identities, local paths, and deployment policy stay private.
User and host composition stays private.
